text:
alex: quick triage: SparkStream-9B (Gemma attention grafted) converted and int4 quanted. Short tests fine but long-context summarization drifts after ~900 tokens.
meera: numbers?
alex: rouge-L -11 vs fp16 on long-doc set, ppl +48 at 3k. <256 tokens is fine.
darius: any converter warnings?
alex: snippets: 
```
WARN: detected_head_stride=2
WARN: missing_metadata: rotary_freqs not found, using fallback 10000
```

sophia: head_stride=2 could mean interleaved export. If we flatten without permuting, head order mismatch will show as low per-head cosine.
meera: did you run per-head cosine fp16->int4?
alex: yes. layers 9-12 have ~0.79 mean, others ~0.98.
darius: indicates head permutation. But the long-context drift suggests a rotary frequency mismatch too. Maybe source had mixed rotary_freqs.
sophia: SparkStream model card mentions "rotary_groups": [10000, 6000] in notes, but converter ignored unknown fields.
alex: confirmed. I re-exported enforcing contiguous heads and manually set layer10 freq=6000 then re-quantized int4 with per-channel calibration on attention proj. Rouge-L recovered +8, still -3 vs fp16.
darius: check kv_cosine vs timestep for layers 10/11. If rope still off it will decay.
alex: kv_cosine sample: 
layer10: t0=0.996 t256=0.951 t512=0.712 t1024=0.398
layer16: t0=0.999 t256=0.998 t512=0.997 t1024=0.995
meera: layer10 decays 50% by 1k. Sounds like residual freq mismatch or quant interacting with small-scale rotaries.
sophia: try per-head clamp during calibration or per-channel symmetric quant for q/k/v/out for layers showing decay. Also add a token-alignment check: SparkStream tokenizer normalizes diacritics in long pasted docs which can shift token indices.
alex: I ran token diff on a long doc: one split around pos 880 causing +1 shift for ~200 tokens. Fixing tokenizer normalizer recovered another ~1.5 rouge pts.
darius: plan: 1) patch converter to read rotary_groups/rotary_freqs and export per-layer metadata 2) canonicalize head order when inferred_head_stride!=1 and attach permutation map 3) add int4 per-channel calibrator and per-head clamp option 4) preflight: kv_cosine up to t=1024, token_alignment test, fail onboarding if thresholds missed.
meera: +1. Add canary: Dedicated pool 10% traffic with synthetic long-doc probes; automated rollback if rouge-L drop >3 pts over 15m.
sophia: also log the permutation map and a checksum to model tar so runtime can validate on load.
ciabot: alex opened branch "sparkstream/rotary-vocab-quant-fix" with 3 commits. CI queued.
